evidence.quote: Safeway operates as a banner of Albertsons Companies
one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States.
Shop produce, meat, seafood and more, guaranteed fresh or your money back.
Check off your grocery list and earn cash back at most grocery stores and supermarkets.
A supermarket offers a wide variety of food and household products
eligible grocery stores and wholesale clubs, supermarkets, meat and seafood stores, candy, nut or confection stores, dairy stores, and bakeries.
This category includes purchases for grocery pickup and delivery that are placed online with grocery stores
Grocery Store purchases include those made at supermarkets, meat lockers, bakeries, smaller grocery stores, and grocery delivery services.

draft.notes: Safeway pages also mention pharmacy-related services, and Citi lists Safeway among merchants excluded from a gas bonus. However, its own page describes the business as a food and drug retailer, while issuer materials list Safeway under grocery merchants; supermarkets is the primary category.
